title: AI Powered Presentation Tools and Techniques

questions.question: How can you insert a chart in Libre Office Impress? a). Click Insert > Chart b). Click Insert > Table c). Click Slide Show > Chart d). Click Format > Chart
questions.solution_html:
• EXAMINATION MARCH 2025
  • Discipline Specific Core Course - MG2DSCCMA100 - AI
  • POWEREDPRESENTATION TOOLS AND TECHNIQUES - SCHEME
  • Appreciation (Ap), and Skill (S)
  • outcome attainability.
  • Multiple Choice Questions
  • Answer all questions. Each question carries 1 mark
  • 1 a) Click Insert > Chart
  • 2 c)View or d). Animation
  • 3 b)Use Master Slides
  • 4 All options are wrong, correct answer is Slide -> Slide properties -> Background
  • (Marks can be given to all options)
  • 5 a)Align and Distribution Toolbar
  • 6 c)Impress
  • 7 a) Press the Shift key
  • 8 a)To save time and give a professional appearance
  • 9 b)To add motion effects to text and objects
  • 10 b)gslides (Complex question) – Marks can be given to all options
  • 11 b)Yes, using File > Print settings and preview > Choose "Print with notes"
  • 12 c) Formatting Toolbar
  • 13 c) PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx) and PDF & d). Audio (.mp3)
  • 14 b)Generating speaker notes and summaries
  • 15 a)Provide well-structured text with key points & b). Copy and paste long
  • unformatted paragraphs
  • 16 b).Canva with AI design features
  • 17 c)Synthesia (Out of syllabus) – Marks can be given to all options
  • 18 b)Protects sensitive data from unauthorized access
  • 19 a) It allows AI-powered automatic customization of slides
  • 20 b)Google Slides
  • (1 × 20 = 20)
  • Short Answer Questions. Answer any 10 questions. Each question carries 3 marks
  • 21 Explanation of changing background colors: (1 mark)
  • You can change the background color of a slide by going to the "Slide" menu and selecting
  • "Set Background". This allows you to choose from solid colors, gradients, hatches, or image
  • backgrounds.
  • Explanation of changing fonts and text styles: (1 mark)
  • Fonts can be customized by selecting the text box and using the "Format" menu. From here
  • you can adjust font type, size, style, and color. The "Master Slide" view can be used to set
  • fonts consistently across slides.
  • Explanation of using themes and layouts: (1 mark)
  • Themes can be applied to change the overall design of slides, including backgrounds, colors
  • and fonts. You can also modify layouts by going to "Master Slide" view and adjusting
  • placeholders and elements, ensuring consistent formatting throughout the presentation.
  • 22 Navigating to the transition option: (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, go to the “Slide Show” menu and select “Slide Transition”.
  • (This opens a sidebar or dialog where you can apply transitions to individual slides.)
  • Selecting a transition effect: (1 mark)
  • From the Slide Transition panel, you can choose a transition style (e.g., Fade, Wipe, Push
  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)
  • Customizing transition settings: (1 mark)
  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)
  • 23 Process of saving a presentation (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, to save a presentation, click on File > Save or press Ctrl + S. If it’s a
  • new file, a dialog box will appear where you can enter the file name and choose a location. After
  • that, click Save to store the presentation.
  • Different file formats available (1 mark)
  • • .ODP (default OpenDocument Presentation format)
  • • .PPT / .PPTX (Microsoft PowerPoint formats)
  • • .PDF (for exporting as a readable, non-editable file)
  • • .OTP (used for saving templates)
  • Importance of saving work frequently (1 mark)
  • Frequent saving helps avoid data loss due to crashes, power failure, or accidental closure. It
  • ensures that recent changes are not lost and protects the user's effort and time.
  • 24 Types of media that can be added (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, you can insert various types of media, including images, audio files, and
  • video files. Supported formats include MP3, WAV (for audio) and MP4, AVI (for video). These
  • elements enhance the presentation's interactivity and appeal.
  • How to insert audio or video files (1 mark)
  • To insert audio or video: Go to Insert > Media > Audio or Video.
  • Select the desired file from your computer. The media object appears on the slide and can be
  • resized or moved like any other object.
  • How to customize audio or video files (1 mark)
  • After inserting, you can: Use the Playback toolbar to play, pause, or stop the media.
  • Set options such as automatic start or play on click.Adjust the volume, and loop playback if
  • needed.
  • 25 Accessing the share option (1 mark)
  • Open the presentation in Google Slides and click on the “Share” button at the top-right corner.
  • This opens the sharing settings window where you can manage access and permissions.
  • Choosing who to share with (1 mark)
  • You can share the presentation by: Entering email addresses of specific people Or by generating
  • a shareable link. You can control access by selecting permissions such as Viewer, Commenter
  • or Editor for each person or link.
  • Adjusting visibility and privacy settings (1 mark)
  • You can choose whether the file is
  • Restricted (only invited users can view)
  • Anyone with the link can view, comment, or edit. These settings ensure the right level of
  • security and collaboration based on your needs.
  • 26 Opening the linked chart for editing (1 mark)
  • To edit a linked chart (e.g., one inserted from Calc into Impress or Writer), double-click the
  • chart. This opens it in Chart Edit mode, allowing access to its data and layout features.
  • Modifying the chart data (1 mark)
  • To change the data: Click “Edit Data” or use the data table that appears.
  • You can directly update values, labels, or categories in the embedded sheet-like editor.
  • Changes are reflected immediately in the chart preview.
  • Updating linked charts (1 mark)
  • If the chart is linked to an external Calc file: Make changes in the source spreadsheet.
  • When you open the document with the linked chart (e.g., Impress), you will be prompted to
  • update the link. Click “Yes” to refresh the chart with the updated data.
  • 27 Enhancing functionality (1 mark)
  • Add-ons expand the built-in capabilities of Google Slides by adding specialized tools and
  • features. For example, add-ons can help with diagram creation, icon insertion, or text
  • formatting, which are not available by default.
  • Improving productivity (1 mark)
  • Add-ons save time and effort by automating repetitive tasks and offering quick solutions for
  • design, formatting, or content insertion. Tools like SlidesAI or Pear Deck help in creating
  • engaging slides and interactive presentations faster.
  • Seamless integration and customization (1 mark)
  • Add-ons work directly within Google Slides and integrate smoothly with other Google
  • Workspace apps. Users can customize presentations based on specific needs without
  • switching between platforms, making workflow more efficient.
  • 28 Accessing slide thumbnails (1 mark)
  • In Google Slides, the list of all slides appears as thumbnails on the left pane of the screen.
  • This view helps users easily identify and select slides for rearrangement.
  • Reordering the slides (1 mark)
  • To rearrange, simply click and drag a slide thumbnail up or down in the slide list. A line
  • indicator shows the new position where the slide will be placed when dropped.
  • Ensuring proper flow (1 mark)
  • Reordering slides helps in organizing the logical flow of the presentation. It allows presenters
  • to group related content, improve narrative structure, and ensure better audience
  • engagement.
  • 29 Real-time collaboration features (1 mark)
  • Yes, Gamma AI supports real-time content editing, allowing multiple users to work on the
  • same presentation simultaneously. This functionality is similar to Google Docs, where users
  • can edit, add comments, and suggest changes in real-time.
  • Benefits of real-time editing (1 mark)
  • This feature is highly beneficial for teams working remotely or across different time zones, as
  • it enables synchronized collaboration. Team members can make immediate updates
  • ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow.
  • Version history tracking (1 mark)
  • Gamma AI also offers version history tracking, allowing users to view or revert to previous
  • versions of the presentation. This feature ensures that all changes are documented and gives
  • users the flexibility to manage content evolution effectively.
  • 30 Canva Magic Design for Presentations (1 mark)
  • Canva’s Magic Design allows users to create presentations by simply typing a prompt. The AI
  • generates customizable templates, including content and layout, which can be edited further to
  • match specific branding or style preferences. (canva.com)
  • SlidesAI (1 mark)
  • SlidesAI is a Google Slides add-on that transforms text prompts into slide decks. It simplifies
  • the process of generating presentations for users with no design expertise, all within Google
  • Slides. (slidesai.io)
  • Gamma (1 mark)
  • Gamma is an AI design tool that automatically generates visually appealing presentations
  • from text prompts. It helps create professional-quality slides without requiring coding or
  • design skills. (gamma.app)
  • *** Or other AI Slide generation tools like Plus AI, MagicSlides, Simplified
  • AI & Tome.
  • 31 Automated slide creation (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design tools automatically generate presentations by analyzing text input or
  • prompts. These tools use machine learning to create slides that are visually appealing and
  • well-structured without requiring manual design effort. For example, tools like Canva Magic
  • Design or Gamma automatically suggest layouts, fonts, colors, and images that align with the
  • content.
  • Personalization and customization (1 mark)
  • AI tools offer customization options, allowing users to tailor the generated designs. Users can
  • modify layouts, colors, fonts, and even content based on specific preferences or branding
  • requirements, ensuring the presentation reflects the desired style and tone.
  • Efficiency and time-saving (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design significantly speeds up the presentation creation process. It
  • automates tasks like formatting, content alignment, and design selection, allowing users to
  • focus on refining the message. This is especially beneficial for users with limited design
  • experience or tight deadlines.
  • 32 Standardized templates and design guidelines (1 mark)
  • Plus AI ensures consistency by utilizing pre-set templates and design guidelines that include
  • specific font styles and color palettes. These templates are designed to maintain a uniform
  • look throughout the presentation, helping users avoid mismatched fonts and colors.
  • Automatic style application (1 mark)
  • When creating slides, Plus AI automatically applies the chosen font and color scheme to all
  • elements in the presentation. This eliminates the need for manual adjustments and ensures that
  • every slide follows the same visual style, promoting consistency.
  • Customizable branding options (1 mark)
  • Plus AI allows users to input their own branding guidelines, including specific fonts and
  • color codes. This customization ensures that all slides created using the tool adhere to the
  • brand’s identity, maintaining professional and consistent design throughout the presentation.
  • (3 × 10 = 30)

  • and fonts. You can also modify layouts by going to "Master Slide" view and adjusting
  • placeholders and elements, ensuring consistent formatting throughout the presentation.

  • (This opens a sidebar or dialog where you can apply transitions to individual slides.)
  • Selecting a transition effect: (1 mark)
  • From the Slide Transition panel, you can choose a transition style (e.g., Fade, Wipe, Push
  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)
  • Customizing transition settings: (1 mark)
  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)

  • new file, a dialog box will appear where you can enter the file name and choose a location. After
  • that, click Save to store the presentation.

  • • .ODP (default OpenDocument Presentation format)
  • • .PPT / .PPTX (Microsoft PowerPoint formats)
  • • .PDF (for exporting as a readable, non-editable file)
  • • .OTP (used for saving templates)

  • Frequent saving helps avoid data loss due to crashes, power failure, or accidental closure. It
  • ensures that recent changes are not lost and protects the user's effort and time.

  • elements enhance the presentation's interactivity and appeal.

  • Select the desired file from your computer. The media object appears on the slide and can be

  • After inserting, you can: Use the Playback toolbar to play, pause, or stop the media.

  • This opens the sharing settings window where you can manage access and permissions.

  • You can share the presentation by: Entering email addresses of specific people Or by generating
  • a shareable link. You can control access by selecting permissions such as Viewer, Commenter
  • or Editor for each person or link.
  • Adjusting visibility and privacy settings (1 mark)
  • You can choose whether the file is
  • Restricted (only invited users can view)
  • Anyone with the link can view, comment, or edit. These settings ensure the right level of
  • security and collaboration based on your needs.

  • You can directly update values, labels, or categories in the embedded sheet-like editor.

  • If the chart is linked to an external Calc file: Make changes in the source spreadsheet.

  • prompts. These tools use machine learning to create slides that are visually appealing and
  • well-structured without requiring manual design effort. For example, tools like Canva Magic
  • Design or Gamma automatically suggest layouts, fonts, colors, and images that align with the
  • content.

  • modify layouts, colors, fonts, and even content based on specific preferences or branding
  • requirements, ensuring the presentation reflects the desired style and tone.

  • automates tasks like formatting, content alignment, and design selection, allowing users to
  • focus on refining the message. This is especially beneficial for users with limited design
  • experience or tight deadlines.

  • specific font styles and color palettes. These templates are designed to maintain a uniform
  • look throughout the presentation, helping users avoid mismatched fonts and colors.
  • Automatic style application (1 mark)

  • elements in the presentation. This eliminates the need for manual adjustments and ensures that
  • every slide follows the same visual style, promoting consistency.
  • Customizable branding options (1 mark)
  • Plus AI allows users to input their own branding guidelines, including specific fonts and
  • color codes. This customization ensures that all slides created using the tool adhere to the
  • brand’s identity, maintaining professional and consistent design throughout the presentation.

  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)

  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)

  • You can choose whether the file is

  • backgrounds.

  • you can adjust font type, size, style, and color. The "Master Slide" view can be used to set
  • fonts consistently across slides.
  • Explanation of using themes and layouts: (1 mark)
  • Themes can be applied to change the overall design of slides, including backgrounds, colors
  • and fonts. You can also modify layouts by going to "Master Slide" view and adjusting
  • placeholders and elements, ensuring consistent formatting throughout the presentation.

  • (This opens a sidebar or dialog where you can apply transitions to individual slides.)

  • From the Slide Transition panel, you can choose a transition style (e.g., Fade, Wipe, Push
  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)

  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)

  • new file, a dialog box will appear where you can enter the file name and choose a location. After
  • that, click Save to store the presentation.
  • Different file formats available (1 mark)
  • • .ODP (default OpenDocument Presentation format)
  • • .PPT / .PPTX (Microsoft PowerPoint formats)
  • • .PDF (for exporting as a readable, non-editable file)
  • • .OTP (used for saving templates)

  • Frequent saving helps avoid data loss due to crashes, power failure, or accidental closure. It
  • ensures that recent changes are not lost and protects the user's effort and time.

  • elements enhance the presentation's interactivity and appeal.

  • To insert audio or video: Go to Insert > Media > Audio or Video.
  • Select the desired file from your computer. The media object appears on the slide and can be
  • resized or moved like any other object.

  • After inserting, you can: Use the Playback toolbar to play, pause, or stop the media.

  • You can share the presentation by: Entering email addresses of specific people Or by generating
  • a shareable link. You can control access by selecting permissions such as Viewer, Commenter
  • or Editor for each person or link.
  • Adjusting visibility and privacy settings (1 mark)
  • You can choose whether the file is
  • Restricted (only invited users can view)
  • Anyone with the link can view, comment, or edit. These settings ensure the right level of
  • security and collaboration based on your needs.

  • To change the data: Click “Edit Data” or use the data table that appears.
  • You can directly update values, labels, or categories in the embedded sheet-like editor.
  • Changes are reflected immediately in the chart preview.

  • If the chart is linked to an external Calc file: Make changes in the source spreadsheet.
  • When you open the document with the linked chart (e.g., Impress), you will be prompted to
  • update the link. Click “Yes” to refresh the chart with the updated data.

  • Add-ons expand the built-in capabilities of Google Slides by adding specialized tools and
  • features. For example, add-ons can help with diagram creation, icon insertion, or text
  • formatting, which are not available by default.
  • Improving productivity (1 mark)
  • Add-ons save time and effort by automating repetitive tasks and offering quick solutions for
  • design, formatting, or content insertion. Tools like SlidesAI or Pear Deck help in creating
  • engaging slides and interactive presentations faster.
  • Seamless integration and customization (1 mark)
  • Add-ons work directly within Google Slides and integrate smoothly with other Google
  • Workspace apps. Users can customize presentations based on specific needs without
  • switching between platforms, making workflow more efficient.

  • In Google Slides, the list of all slides appears as thumbnails on the left pane of the screen.
  • This view helps users easily identify and select slides for rearrangement.

  • To rearrange, simply click and drag a slide thumbnail up or down in the slide list. A line
  • indicator shows the new position where the slide will be placed when dropped.
  • Ensuring proper flow (1 mark)
  • Reordering slides helps in organizing the logical flow of the presentation. It allows presenters
  • to group related content, improve narrative structure, and ensure better audience
  • engagement.

  • can edit, add comments, and suggest changes in real-time.

  • This feature is highly beneficial for teams working remotely or across different time zones, as
  • it enables synchronized collaboration. Team members can make immediate updates
  • ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow.

  • Gamma AI also offers version history tracking, allowing users to view or revert to previous
  • versions of the presentation. This feature ensures that all changes are documented and gives
  • users the flexibility to manage content evolution effectively.

  • from text prompts. It helps create professional-quality slides without requiring coding or
  • design skills. (gamma.app)

  • AI & Tome.

  • AI-powered slide design tools automatically generate presentations by analyzing text input or
  • prompts. These tools use machine learning to create slides that are visually appealing and
  • well-structured without requiring manual design effort. For example, tools like Canva Magic
  • Design or Gamma automatically suggest layouts, fonts, colors, and images that align with the
  • content.
  • Personalization and customization (1 mark)
  • AI tools offer customization options, allowing users to tailor the generated designs. Users can
  • modify layouts, colors, fonts, and even content based on specific preferences or branding
  • requirements, ensuring the presentation reflects the desired style and tone.

  • AI-powered slide design significantly speeds up the presentation creation process. It
  • automates tasks like formatting, content alignment, and design selection, allowing users to
  • focus on refining the message. This is especially beneficial for users with limited design
  • experience or tight deadlines.
  • 32 Standardized templates and design guidelines (1 mark)
  • Plus AI ensures consistency by utilizing pre-set templates and design guidelines that include
  • specific font styles and color palettes. These templates are designed to maintain a uniform
  • look throughout the presentation, helping users avoid mismatched fonts and colors.
  • Automatic style application (1 mark)
  • When creating slides, Plus AI automatically applies the chosen font and color scheme to all
  • elements in the presentation. This eliminates the need for manual adjustments and ensures that
  • every slide follows the same visual style, promoting consistency.
  • Customizable branding options (1 mark)
  • Plus AI allows users to input their own branding guidelines, including specific fonts and
  • color codes. This customization ensures that all slides created using the tool adhere to the
  • brand’s identity, maintaining professional and consistent design throughout the presentation.

  • you can adjust font type, size, style, and color. The "Master Slide" view can be used to set
  • fonts consistently across slides.
  • Explanation of using themes and layouts: (1 mark)
  • Themes can be applied to change the overall design of slides, including backgrounds, colors
  • and fonts. You can also modify layouts by going to "Master Slide" view and adjusting
  • placeholders and elements, ensuring consistent formatting throughout the presentation.
  • 22 Navigating to the transition option: (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, go to the “Slide Show” menu and select “Slide Transition”.
  • (This opens a sidebar or dialog where you can apply transitions to individual slides.)
  • Selecting a transition effect: (1 mark)
  • From the Slide Transition panel, you can choose a transition style (e.g., Fade, Wipe, Push
  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)
  • Customizing transition settings: (1 mark)
  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)
  • 23 Process of saving a presentation (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, to save a presentation, click on File > Save or press Ctrl + S. If it’s a
  • new file, a dialog box will appear where you can enter the file name and choose a location. After
  • that, click Save to store the presentation.
  • Different file formats available (1 mark)
  • • .ODP (default OpenDocument Presentation format)
  • • .PPT / .PPTX (Microsoft PowerPoint formats)
  • • .PDF (for exporting as a readable, non-editable file)
  • • .OTP (used for saving templates)
  • Importance of saving work frequently (1 mark)
  • Frequent saving helps avoid data loss due to crashes, power failure, or accidental closure. It
  • ensures that recent changes are not lost and protects the user's effort and time.
  • 24 Types of media that can be added (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, you can insert various types of media, including images, audio files, and
  • video files. Supported formats include MP3, WAV (for audio) and MP4, AVI (for video). These
  • elements enhance the presentation's interactivity and appeal.
  • How to insert audio or video files (1 mark)
  • To insert audio or video: Go to Insert > Media > Audio or Video.
  • Select the desired file from your computer. The media object appears on the slide and can be
  • resized or moved like any other object.
  • How to customize audio or video files (1 mark)
  • After inserting, you can: Use the Playback toolbar to play, pause, or stop the media.
  • Set options such as automatic start or play on click.Adjust the volume, and loop playback if
  • needed.
  • 25 Accessing the share option (1 mark)
  • Open the presentation in Google Slides and click on the “Share” button at the top-right corner.
  • This opens the sharing settings window where you can manage access and permissions.
  • Choosing who to share with (1 mark)
  • You can share the presentation by: Entering email addresses of specific people Or by generating
  • a shareable link. You can control access by selecting permissions such as Viewer, Commenter
  • or Editor for each person or link.
  • Adjusting visibility and privacy settings (1 mark)
  • You can choose whether the file is
  • Restricted (only invited users can view)
  • Anyone with the link can view, comment, or edit. These settings ensure the right level of
  • security and collaboration based on your needs.
  • 26 Opening the linked chart for editing (1 mark)

  • chart. This opens it in Chart Edit mode, allowing access to its data and layout features.
  • Modifying the chart data (1 mark)
  • To change the data: Click “Edit Data” or use the data table that appears.
  • You can directly update values, labels, or categories in the embedded sheet-like editor.
  • Changes are reflected immediately in the chart preview.
  • Updating linked charts (1 mark)
  • If the chart is linked to an external Calc file: Make changes in the source spreadsheet.
  • When you open the document with the linked chart (e.g., Impress), you will be prompted to
  • update the link. Click “Yes” to refresh the chart with the updated data.

  • Add-ons expand the built-in capabilities of Google Slides by adding specialized tools and
  • features. For example, add-ons can help with diagram creation, icon insertion, or text
  • formatting, which are not available by default.
  • Improving productivity (1 mark)
  • Add-ons save time and effort by automating repetitive tasks and offering quick solutions for
  • design, formatting, or content insertion. Tools like SlidesAI or Pear Deck help in creating
  • engaging slides and interactive presentations faster.
  • Seamless integration and customization (1 mark)
  • Add-ons work directly within Google Slides and integrate smoothly with other Google
  • Workspace apps. Users can customize presentations based on specific needs without
  • switching between platforms, making workflow more efficient.
  • 28 Accessing slide thumbnails (1 mark)
  • In Google Slides, the list of all slides appears as thumbnails on the left pane of the screen.
  • This view helps users easily identify and select slides for rearrangement.
  • Reordering the slides (1 mark)
  • To rearrange, simply click and drag a slide thumbnail up or down in the slide list. A line
  • indicator shows the new position where the slide will be placed when dropped.
  • Ensuring proper flow (1 mark)
  • Reordering slides helps in organizing the logical flow of the presentation. It allows presenters
  • to group related content, improve narrative structure, and ensure better audience
  • engagement.
  • 29 Real-time collaboration features (1 mark)
  • Yes, Gamma AI supports real-time content editing, allowing multiple users to work on the
  • same presentation simultaneously. This functionality is similar to Google Docs, where users
  • can edit, add comments, and suggest changes in real-time.
  • Benefits of real-time editing (1 mark)
  • This feature is highly beneficial for teams working remotely or across different time zones, as
  • it enables synchronized collaboration. Team members can make immediate updates
  • ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow.
  • Version history tracking (1 mark)
  • Gamma AI also offers version history tracking, allowing users to view or revert to previous
  • versions of the presentation. This feature ensures that all changes are documented and gives
  • users the flexibility to manage content evolution effectively.

  • generates customizable templates, including content and layout, which can be edited further to
  • match specific branding or style preferences. (canva.com)

  • SlidesAI is a Google Slides add-on that transforms text prompts into slide decks. It simplifies
  • the process of generating presentations for users with no design expertise, all within Google
  • Slides. (slidesai.io)
  • Gamma (1 mark)
  • Gamma is an AI design tool that automatically generates visually appealing presentations
  • from text prompts. It helps create professional-quality slides without requiring coding or
  • design skills. (gamma.app)
  • *** Or other AI Slide generation tools like Plus AI, MagicSlides, Simplified
  • AI & Tome.

  • AI-powered slide design tools automatically generate presentations by analyzing text input or
  • prompts. These tools use machine learning to create slides that are visually appealing and
  • well-structured without requiring manual design effort. For example, tools like Canva Magic
  • Design or Gamma automatically suggest layouts, fonts, colors, and images that align with the
  • content.
  • Personalization and customization (1 mark)
  • AI tools offer customization options, allowing users to tailor the generated designs. Users can
  • modify layouts, colors, fonts, and even content based on specific preferences or branding
  • requirements, ensuring the presentation reflects the desired style and tone.
  • Efficiency and time-saving (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design significantly speeds up the presentation creation process. It
  • automates tasks like formatting, content alignment, and design selection, allowing users to
  • focus on refining the message. This is especially beneficial for users with limited design
  • experience or tight deadlines.
  • 32 Standardized templates and design guidelines (1 mark)
  • Plus AI ensures consistency by utilizing pre-set templates and design guidelines that include
  • specific font styles and color palettes. These templates are designed to maintain a uniform
  • look throughout the presentation, helping users avoid mismatched fonts and colors.
  • Automatic style application (1 mark)
  • When creating slides, Plus AI automatically applies the chosen font and color scheme to all
  • elements in the presentation. This eliminates the need for manual adjustments and ensures that
  • every slide follows the same visual style, promoting consistency.
  • Customizable branding options (1 mark)
  • Plus AI allows users to input their own branding guidelines, including specific fonts and
  • color codes. This customization ensures that all slides created using the tool adhere to the
  • brand’s identity, maintaining professional and consistent design throughout the presentation.

  • "Set Background". This allows you to choose from solid colors, gradients, hatches, or image
  • backgrounds.

  • Fonts can be customized by selecting the text box and using the "Format" menu. From here
  • you can adjust font type, size, style, and color. The "Master Slide" view can be used to set
  • fonts consistently across slides.
  • Explanation of using themes and layouts: (1 mark)
  • Themes can be applied to change the overall design of slides, including backgrounds, colors
  • and fonts. You can also modify layouts by going to "Master Slide" view and adjusting
  • placeholders and elements, ensuring consistent formatting throughout the presentation.
  • 22 Navigating to the transition option: (1 mark)

  • (This opens a sidebar or dialog where you can apply transitions to individual slides.)
  • Selecting a transition effect: (1 mark)
  • From the Slide Transition panel, you can choose a transition style (e.g., Fade, Wipe, Push
  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)

  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)

  • new file, a dialog box will appear where you can enter the file name and choose a location. After
  • that, click Save to store the presentation.

  • • .ODP (default OpenDocument Presentation format)
  • • .PPT / .PPTX (Microsoft PowerPoint formats)
  • • .PDF (for exporting as a readable, non-editable file)
  • • .OTP (used for saving templates)

  • Frequent saving helps avoid data loss due to crashes, power failure, or accidental closure. It
  • ensures that recent changes are not lost and protects the user's effort and time.

  • elements enhance the presentation's interactivity and appeal.

  • Select the desired file from your computer. The media object appears on the slide and can be
  • resized or moved like any other object.

  • After inserting, you can: Use the Playback toolbar to play, pause, or stop the media.

  • or Editor for each person or link.

  • You can choose whether the file is
  • Restricted (only invited users can view)
  • Anyone with the link can view, comment, or edit. These settings ensure the right level of
  • security and collaboration based on your needs.

  • To change the data: Click “Edit Data” or use the data table that appears.
  • You can directly update values, labels, or categories in the embedded sheet-like editor.
  • Changes are reflected immediately in the chart preview.
  • Updating linked charts (1 mark)
  • If the chart is linked to an external Calc file: Make changes in the source spreadsheet.
  • When you open the document with the linked chart (e.g., Impress), you will be prompted to
  • update the link. Click “Yes” to refresh the chart with the updated data.

  • Add-ons expand the built-in capabilities of Google Slides by adding specialized tools and
  • features. For example, add-ons can help with diagram creation, icon insertion, or text
  • formatting, which are not available by default.
  • Improving productivity (1 mark)
  • Add-ons save time and effort by automating repetitive tasks and offering quick solutions for
  • design, formatting, or content insertion. Tools like SlidesAI or Pear Deck help in creating
  • engaging slides and interactive presentations faster.
  • Seamless integration and customization (1 mark)
  • Add-ons work directly within Google Slides and integrate smoothly with other Google
  • Workspace apps. Users can customize presentations based on specific needs without
  • switching between platforms, making workflow more efficient.
  • 28 Accessing slide thumbnails (1 mark)
  • In Google Slides, the list of all slides appears as thumbnails on the left pane of the screen.
  • This view helps users easily identify and select slides for rearrangement.

  • To rearrange, simply click and drag a slide thumbnail up or down in the slide list. A line
  • indicator shows the new position where the slide will be placed when dropped.
  • Ensuring proper flow (1 mark)
  • Reordering slides helps in organizing the logical flow of the presentation. It allows presenters
  • to group related content, improve narrative structure, and ensure better audience
  • engagement.
  • 29 Real-time collaboration features (1 mark)
  • Yes, Gamma AI supports real-time content editing, allowing multiple users to work on the

  • can edit, add comments, and suggest changes in real-time.

  • This feature is highly beneficial for teams working remotely or across different time zones, as
  • it enables synchronized collaboration. Team members can make immediate updates
  • ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow.
  • Version history tracking (1 mark)
  • Gamma AI also offers version history tracking, allowing users to view or revert to previous
  • versions of the presentation. This feature ensures that all changes are documented and gives
  • users the flexibility to manage content evolution effectively.

  • generates customizable templates, including content and layout, which can be edited further to
  • match specific branding or style preferences. (canva.com)

  • the process of generating presentations for users with no design expertise, all within Google
  • Slides. (slidesai.io)
  • Gamma (1 mark)
  • Gamma is an AI design tool that automatically generates visually appealing presentations
  • from text prompts. It helps create professional-quality slides without requiring coding or
  • design skills. (gamma.app)
  • *** Or other AI Slide generation tools like Plus AI, MagicSlides, Simplified
  • AI & Tome.
  • 31 Automated slide creation (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design tools automatically generate presentations by analyzing text input or
  • prompts. These tools use machine learning to create slides that are visually appealing and
  • well-structured without requiring manual design effort. For example, tools like Canva Magic
  • Design or Gamma automatically suggest layouts, fonts, colors, and images that align with the
  • content.
  • Personalization and customization (1 mark)
  • AI tools offer customization options, allowing users to tailor the generated designs. Users can
  • modify layouts, colors, fonts, and even content based on specific preferences or branding
  • requirements, ensuring the presentation reflects the desired style and tone.
  • Efficiency and time-saving (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design significantly speeds up the presentation creation process. It
  • automates tasks like formatting, content alignment, and design selection, allowing users to
  • focus on refining the message. This is especially beneficial for users with limited design
  • experience or tight deadlines.
  • 32 Standardized templates and design guidelines (1 mark)
  • Plus AI ensures consistency by utilizing pre-set templates and design guidelines that include
  • specific font styles and color palettes. These templates are designed to maintain a uniform
  • look throughout the presentation, helping users avoid mismatched fonts and colors.
  • Automatic style application (1 mark)
  • When creating slides, Plus AI automatically applies the chosen font and color scheme to all
  • elements in the presentation. This eliminates the need for manual adjustments and ensures that
  • every slide follows the same visual style, promoting consistency.
  • Customizable branding options (1 mark)
  • Plus AI allows users to input their own branding guidelines, including specific fonts and
  • color codes. This customization ensures that all slides created using the tool adhere to the
  • brand’s identity, maintaining professional and consistent design throughout the presentation.

  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)

  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)

  • You can share the presentation by: Entering email addresses of specific people Or by generating

  • You can choose whether the file is
  • Restricted (only invited users can view)
  • Anyone with the link can view, comment, or edit. These settings ensure the right level of

  • To change the data: Click “Edit Data” or use the data table that appears.
  • You can directly update values, labels, or categories in the embedded sheet-like editor.
  • Changes are reflected immediately in the chart preview.
  • Updating linked charts (1 mark)
  • If the chart is linked to an external Calc file: Make changes in the source spreadsheet.
  • When you open the document with the linked chart (e.g., Impress), you will be prompted to
  • update the link. Click “Yes” to refresh the chart with the updated data.

  • features. For example, add-ons can help with diagram creation, icon insertion, or text
  • formatting, which are not available by default.

  • Add-ons save time and effort by automating repetitive tasks and offering quick solutions for
  • design, formatting, or content insertion. Tools like SlidesAI or Pear Deck help in creating
  • engaging slides and interactive presentations faster.

  • Add-ons work directly within Google Slides and integrate smoothly with other Google
  • Workspace apps. Users can customize presentations based on specific needs without
  • switching between platforms, making workflow more efficient.

  • This view helps users easily identify and select slides for rearrangement.

  • To rearrange, simply click and drag a slide thumbnail up or down in the slide list. A line
  • indicator shows the new position where the slide will be placed when dropped.
  • Ensuring proper flow (1 mark)
  • Reordering slides helps in organizing the logical flow of the presentation. It allows presenters
  • to group related content, improve narrative structure, and ensure better audience
  • engagement.

  • Yes, Gamma AI supports real-time content editing, allowing multiple users to work on the

  • can edit, add comments, and suggest changes in real-time.

  • This feature is highly beneficial for teams working remotely or across different time zones, as
  • it enables synchronized collaboration. Team members can make immediate updates
  • ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow.

  • Gamma AI also offers version history tracking, allowing users to view or revert to previous
  • versions of the presentation. This feature ensures that all changes are documented and gives
  • users the flexibility to manage content evolution effectively.

  • from text prompts. It helps create professional-quality slides without requiring coding or
  • design skills. (gamma.app)

  • prompts. These tools use machine learning to create slides that are visually appealing and
  • well-structured without requiring manual design effort. For example, tools like Canva Magic
  • Design or Gamma automatically suggest layouts, fonts, colors, and images that align with the
  • content.

  • experience or tight deadlines.

  • specific font styles and color palettes. These templates are designed to maintain a uniform
  • look throughout the presentation, helping users avoid mismatched fonts and colors.

  • When creating slides, Plus AI automatically applies the chosen font and color scheme to all

  • every slide follows the same visual style, promoting consistency.

  • Plus AI allows users to input their own branding guidelines, including specific fonts and
  • color codes. This customization ensures that all slides created using the tool adhere to the
  • brand’s identity, maintaining professional and consistent design throughout the presentation.

  • "Set Background". This allows you to choose from solid colors, gradients, hatches, or image
  • backgrounds.
  • Explanation of changing fonts and text styles: (1 mark)
  • Fonts can be customized by selecting the text box and using the "Format" menu. From here
  • you can adjust font type, size, style, and color. The "Master Slide" view can be used to set
  • fonts consistently across slides.
  • Explanation of using themes and layouts: (1 mark)
  • Themes can be applied to change the overall design of slides, including backgrounds, colors
  • and fonts. You can also modify layouts by going to "Master Slide" view and adjusting
  • placeholders and elements, ensuring consistent formatting throughout the presentation.
  • 22 Navigating to the transition option: (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, go to the “Slide Show” menu and select “Slide Transition”.
  • (This opens a sidebar or dialog where you can apply transitions to individual slides.)
  • Selecting a transition effect: (1 mark)
  • From the Slide Transition panel, you can choose a transition style (e.g., Fade, Wipe, Push
  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)
  • Customizing transition settings: (1 mark)
  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)

  • new file, a dialog box will appear where you can enter the file name and choose a location. After
  • that, click Save to store the presentation.
  • Different file formats available (1 mark)
  • • .ODP (default OpenDocument Presentation format)
  • • .PPT / .PPTX (Microsoft PowerPoint formats)
  • • .PDF (for exporting as a readable, non-editable file)
  • • .OTP (used for saving templates)
  • Importance of saving work frequently (1 mark)
  • Frequent saving helps avoid data loss due to crashes, power failure, or accidental closure. It
  • ensures that recent changes are not lost and protects the user's effort and time.

  • In LibreOffice Impress, you can insert various types of media, including images, audio files, and
  • video files. Supported formats include MP3, WAV (for audio) and MP4, AVI (for video). These
  • elements enhance the presentation's interactivity and appeal.
  • How to insert audio or video files (1 mark)
  • To insert audio or video: Go to Insert > Media > Audio or Video.
  • Select the desired file from your computer. The media object appears on the slide and can be
  • resized or moved like any other object.

  • After inserting, you can: Use the Playback toolbar to play, pause, or stop the media.

  • Choosing who to share with (1 mark)
  • You can share the presentation by: Entering email addresses of specific people Or by generating
  • a shareable link. You can control access by selecting permissions such as Viewer, Commenter
  • or Editor for each person or link.
  • Adjusting visibility and privacy settings (1 mark)
  • You can choose whether the file is
  • Restricted (only invited users can view)
  • Anyone with the link can view, comment, or edit. These settings ensure the right level of
  • security and collaboration based on your needs.

  • chart. This opens it in Chart Edit mode, allowing access to its data and layout features.

  • To change the data: Click “Edit Data” or use the data table that appears.
  • You can directly update values, labels, or categories in the embedded sheet-like editor.
  • Changes are reflected immediately in the chart preview.
  • Updating linked charts (1 mark)
  • If the chart is linked to an external Calc file: Make changes in the source spreadsheet.
  • When you open the document with the linked chart (e.g., Impress), you will be prompted to
  • update the link. Click “Yes” to refresh the chart with the updated data.

  • features. For example, add-ons can help with diagram creation, icon insertion, or text
  • formatting, which are not available by default.
  • Improving productivity (1 mark)
  • Add-ons save time and effort by automating repetitive tasks and offering quick solutions for
  • design, formatting, or content insertion. Tools like SlidesAI or Pear Deck help in creating
  • engaging slides and interactive presentations faster.
  • Seamless integration and customization (1 mark)
  • Add-ons work directly within Google Slides and integrate smoothly with other Google
  • Workspace apps. Users can customize presentations based on specific needs without
  • switching between platforms, making workflow more efficient.
  • 28 Accessing slide thumbnails (1 mark)
  • In Google Slides, the list of all slides appears as thumbnails on the left pane of the screen.
  • This view helps users easily identify and select slides for rearrangement.
  • Reordering the slides (1 mark)
  • To rearrange, simply click and drag a slide thumbnail up or down in the slide list. A line
  • indicator shows the new position where the slide will be placed when dropped.
  • Ensuring proper flow (1 mark)
  • Reordering slides helps in organizing the logical flow of the presentation. It allows presenters
  • to group related content, improve narrative structure, and ensure better audience
  • engagement.
  • 29 Real-time collaboration features (1 mark)
  • Yes, Gamma AI supports real-time content editing, allowing multiple users to work on the
  • same presentation simultaneously. This functionality is similar to Google Docs, where users
  • can edit, add comments, and suggest changes in real-time.
  • Benefits of real-time editing (1 mark)
  • This feature is highly beneficial for teams working remotely or across different time zones, as
  • it enables synchronized collaboration. Team members can make immediate updates
  • ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow.
  • Version history tracking (1 mark)
  • Gamma AI also offers version history tracking, allowing users to view or revert to previous
  • versions of the presentation. This feature ensures that all changes are documented and gives
  • users the flexibility to manage content evolution effectively.
  • 30 Canva Magic Design for Presentations (1 mark)
  • Canva’s Magic Design allows users to create presentations by simply typing a prompt. The AI
  • generates customizable templates, including content and layout, which can be edited further to
  • match specific branding or style preferences. (canva.com)
  • SlidesAI (1 mark)
  • SlidesAI is a Google Slides add-on that transforms text prompts into slide decks. It simplifies
  • the process of generating presentations for users with no design expertise, all within Google
  • Slides. (slidesai.io)
  • Gamma (1 mark)
  • Gamma is an AI design tool that automatically generates visually appealing presentations
  • from text prompts. It helps create professional-quality slides without requiring coding or
  • design skills. (gamma.app)
  • *** Or other AI Slide generation tools like Plus AI, MagicSlides, Simplified
  • AI & Tome.
  • 31 Automated slide creation (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design tools automatically generate presentations by analyzing text input or
  • prompts. These tools use machine learning to create slides that are visually appealing and
  • well-structured without requiring manual design effort. For example, tools like Canva Magic
  • Design or Gamma automatically suggest layouts, fonts, colors, and images that align with the
  • content.
  • Personalization and customization (1 mark)
  • AI tools offer customization options, allowing users to tailor the generated designs. Users can
  • modify layouts, colors, fonts, and even content based on specific preferences or branding
  • requirements, ensuring the presentation reflects the desired style and tone.
  • Efficiency and time-saving (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design significantly speeds up the presentation creation process. It
  • automates tasks like formatting, content alignment, and design selection, allowing users to
  • focus on refining the message. This is especially beneficial for users with limited design
  • experience or tight deadlines.
  • 32 Standardized templates and design guidelines (1 mark)
  • Plus AI ensures consistency by utilizing pre-set templates and design guidelines that include
  • specific font styles and color palettes. These templates are designed to maintain a uniform
  • look throughout the presentation, helping users avoid mismatched fonts and colors.
  • Automatic style application (1 mark)
  • When creating slides, Plus AI automatically applies the chosen font and color scheme to all
  • elements in the presentation. This eliminates the need for manual adjustments and ensures that
  • every slide follows the same visual style, promoting consistency.
  • Customizable branding options (1 mark)
  • Plus AI allows users to input their own branding guidelines, including specific fonts and
  • color codes. This customization ensures that all slides created using the tool adhere to the
  • brand’s identity, maintaining professional and consistent design throughout the presentation.
